objective: Independent save, cloud search/list, local download and existing-cloud-file delivery, composable without redundant uploads.
requirements: Save local files independently; persist task/object identity and searchable original filenames/manifests. Do not send email implicitly.

List actual Qiniu objects with bounded pagination and prefix/search filters, correlate owned objects with original-file metadata, distinguish unmanaged objects and history from live provider presence. Show enough name, size, timestamp and task/object identifiers to resolve ambiguity before sending.

Download a selected owned archive to an explicit local destination, bounded timeout, streaming SHA256/size verification, private temporary file, atomic publish, no overwrite without explicit request. Encrypted ZIP is the default; extraction is separately requested and uses safe path validation.

Generate a fresh signed handoff for an existing selected owned object without requiring original source paths, repacking or upload; preserve archive/password/object identity, verify live content and record link versions for safe email idempotency.

Email/share accept either local files or an existing cloud selection. Upload only local inputs; reuse existing selected objects. Send mobile HTML notification through the existing SMTP core; unknown sends never retry implicitly.

CLI and MCP share deterministic core operations; Skill routes save/list/download/share/email and their combinations. Missing decisions are limited to file selection, output path, recipient and configuration. No raw credentials in prompts or logs.

Host- and model-neutral Skill: Codex/ChatGPT, Hermes, Claude and other agents use the same CLI/MCP contracts; host discovery/trust/config adapters are separate, no specific inference model or provider is required.
scope_policy: New requirement after FD-007 planning. Freeze implementation scope and deterministic acceptance for each vertical slice before implementation; do not rewrite FD-005/006/007 historical evidence.
slices: Versioned link renewal and existing-object mail/share
verification: Synthetic provider tests first; actual listing/download require a corresponding requested operation. No upload, download or mail has occurred for this planning task.
